1. The customer opens the billing page and clicks upgrade
2. The payment is processed correctly and the confirmation page appears
3. The invoice is generated but it uses the old plan price instead of the new one
4. The next renewal charges the customer the old price again
5. Support has to manually issue a refund and fix the subscription record
